metadata.article_title: Resort to arbitral or judicial proceedings.

article.title: Resort to arbitral or judicial proceedings.
article.content: The parties shall not initiate, during the conciliation proceedings, any arbitral or judicial proceedings in respect of a dispute that is the subject-matter of the conciliation proceedings except that a party may initiate arbitral or judicial proceedings where, in his opinion, such proceedings are necessary for preserving his rights.
article.html:
77Resort to arbitral or judicial proceedings.

Section 77 · Part III · page 37 of the Act

The parties shall not initiate, during the conciliation proceedings, any arbitral or judicial proceedings in respect of a dispute that is the subject-matter of the conciliation proceedings except that a party may initiate arbitral or judicial proceedings where, in his opinion, such proceedings are necessary for preserving his rights.
